title: Custom printed cup sleeves
short_description: Brand the cup you already use. Corrugated kraft cup sleeves printed with your logo — the lowest-cost way to put your name in every hand.
description:
A corrugated kraft sleeve that fits standard 8–16 oz hot cups. One-colour print on kraft keeps the cost down; two-colour and full-colour are quoted on request. If you want to keep your current cups, a printed sleeve is the quickest route to branded drinks. Want the cup itself printed? See our [custom printed double wall coffee cups](/coffee-cups/double-wall-cups/).

Your digital proof and print plates are included in the price. Final specifications are confirmed with your written quote.

faqs.q: Can I use my own design?
faqs.a: Yes. Share your logo or print-ready artwork when requesting a quote. We will confirm the artwork requirements for your chosen item, and you approve a digital proof before anything is printed.

faqs.q: What if my artwork is not ready?
faqs.a: You can request a quote first and share your artwork later. Tell us what you have in mind and we can discuss the next steps.

The prices on this page are indicative and exclude VAT, which is added at 20%. Your digital proof and print plates are included, and delivery is free to a single UK mainland address. We confirm everything in a written quote before you commit.

faqs.q: Do you supply the cups too?
faqs.a: Yes — we print double wall cups with a full-colour wrap, priced online on our double wall cups page. Sleeves suit businesses that want a printed touchpoint without switching cup supplier.
Standard sleeves are delivered 8–9 weeks from artwork approval. Express is 4 weeks from artwork approval for 1,000 or 2,500 sleeves. We confirm timing with your written quote.
